articles.title: Agra Blackmail Tragedy: 27-Year-Old Prince Dies After 53 Calls, Family Alleges Extortion
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing case from Agra, UP: 27-year-old jeweller Raja alias Prince (alias Raja) died by suicide after alleged blackmail and harassment by his ex-girlfriend Kirti Sharma and her associate. Call records show 53 calls from Kirti on the same day.

body.html:
A disturbing case from Agra, UP: 27-year-old jeweller Raja alias Prince (alias Raja) died by suicide after alleged blackmail and harassment by his ex-girlfriend Kirti Sharma and her associate.

Call records show 53 calls from Kirti on the same day. A viral recording captures Prince pleading for time while she allegedly pressures him for money and jewellery worth ₹20 lakh.

Family claims he was threatened with false charges and obscene videos. WhatsApp chats show repeated transfers and demands. Despite the evidence, no arrests yet, raising questions about Agra Police’s action.

An FIR was registered only after 36 days. Prince consumed poison and died while being taken to Delhi for treatment. Family seeks justice.

articles.title: Killed His Own Sister for ‘Honour’? Shocking UP Murder Exposes Brutal Mindset!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case of honour killing has surfaced from Basti, Uttar Pradesh, where a 20-year-old woman was murdered by her brother for speaking to her boyfriend.

body.html:
A shocking case of honour killing has surfaced from Basti, Uttar Pradesh, where a 20-year-old woman was murdered by her brother for speaking to her boyfriend. According to police, the accused Manish, with help from his mother Nirmala Devi, tied the victim’s hands and feet, packed her in a sack, and placed her inside the trunk of their car. He then left for Gonda along with his cousin, Muskan.

On the way, Manish strangled his sister. After reaching Gonda, he dumped her on a deserted roadside and allegedly ran his car over her. Believing she was dead, he fled. The body was recovered on 17 November, following which a murder case was registered.

Gonda SP Vineet Jaiswal formed five investigation teams. CCTV footage showing the accused’s vehicle helped trace the route. After a 13-day probe, police detained Manish, who confessed to killing his sister because she was talking to a boy.

Police have arrested both the mother and the son, while the cousin remains absconding. Officials confirmed that the murder took place on 16 November in the Tarabganj police station area.

The victim, Anuradha, a resident of Parsa Jagir in Basti, was a graduate student. Her elder sister is also pursuing studies, while her elder brother works as a stonemason in Pune.

On the day of the incident, Manish returned from Gorakhpur and saw Anuradha speaking to a boy on the phone, leading to an argument. Later that night, he broke her phone, tied her up with a rope provided by his mother, and put her in a sack before driving off with Muskan.

During the journey, he strangled her to silence her. After failing to reach Ayodhya due to road construction, he travelled towards Gonda via Dubaulia–Vishesharganj, refuelled at Nawabganj, and finally ran her over near PD Dam in Bangaon before fleeing towards Basti.

articles.title: UP Man Walks Into Leopard Trap — Gets Caged Instead of the Big Cat!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A bizarre incident surfaced from Uttar Pradesh’s Bahraich district, where a man ended up trapped inside a leopard cage after allegedly trying to steal a live goat kept as bait. Forest officials had placed two cages with goats to catch a leopard responsible for recent attacks in the area.

body.html:
A bizarre incident surfaced from Uttar Pradesh’s Bahraich district, where a man ended up trapped inside a leopard cage after allegedly trying to steal a live goat kept as bait. Forest officials had placed two cages with goats to catch a leopard responsible for recent attacks in the area.

According to officials, the man, identified as Pradeep, was heavily intoxicated when he spotted the goat inside the cage late at night. Unaware that it was a trap, he attempted to steal the animal and accidentally locked himself inside. He remained trapped with the goat throughout the night.

On Friday morning, forest officials and villagers reached the spot to check if the leopard had been caught, only to find Pradeep sitting inside the cage. He was later released by forest staff.

Forest Inspector Prashikshan Verma said Pradeep even hurled abuses at the forest department and police after being freed. He was handed over to Fakharpur police around 9 pm on Thursday, and a case of attempted theft is being registered against him.

The forest department had set up traps after a leopard killed a woman in the area. Villagers have been advised to remain alert and avoid stepping out alone at night.

body.html:
A massive fire broke out in a four-storey building at Tigri Extension, Sangam Vihar, Delhi, killing four people and injuring two. The blaze began in a footwear shop and rapidly spread upward. articles.title: Inspector Threatens Elderly Woman: ‘I’ll Kick You So Hard You’ll Forget Your Face’
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video of Unnao Sadar police station inspector Uma Agarwal threatening a 60-year-old woman during a case inquiry has triggered major controversy.

body.html:
A video of Unnao Sadar police station inspector Uma Agarwal threatening a 60-year-old woman during a case inquiry has triggered major controversy. The incident occurred in Dakouli village, where Agarwal had gone to serve a notice in a dowry harassment case filed by Rinki, a resident of Banduhar village.

According to the viral clip, Agarwal is seen pointing her finger at the elderly woman and saying, “I’ll kick you so hard you’ll forget your face. I’m not your father’s servant.” The matter reached SP Jaiprakash Singh, who has ordered an inquiry under CO Deepak Yadav, stating that action will be taken based on the investigation report.

Rinki had lodged an FIR against her husband Amit Kumar and his family members for dowry harassment, prompting Agarwal to accompany her to the village on 28 November. An argument broke out between Agarwal and the accused woman’s mother-in-law, Chedana Devi, who alleged that police were forcing her to sign papers and misbehaving with her.

However, Kotwali police claim that when Agarwal reached the spot, villagers became aggressive and even attempted to attack Rinki. They said the viral video shows only a partial view of the incident and that Agarwal intervened to control the situation.

Villagers are now demanding that SI Uma Agarwal be immediately removed from duty and that an apology be issued to the elderly woman.

Inspector Agarwal has previously served at Kanshi Ram and Magarwara police posts and was earlier placed on the line for negligence before being posted at Sadar police station in March this year.

articles.title: Mathura Bar Fight Over ₹30,000 Bill Sparks Outrage — Viral Video Shows Bouncers Thrashing Family
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident from Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, has gone viral after a disagreement over a ₹30,000 bill at a restaurant-bar escalated into a violent clash. According to reports, a local family had hosted a party at the establishment.

body.html:
A shocking incident from Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, has gone viral after a disagreement over a ₹30,000 bill at a restaurant-bar escalated into a violent clash.

According to reports, a local family had hosted a party at the establishment. When the bill was presented, an argument broke out, following which the hotel staff and bouncers allegedly turned aggressive.

In the viral video, men are seen abusing and thrashing customers, while women try to intervene. A man is visibly beaten with a stick. The family alleges that the bouncers assaulted male members, pushed the women, and attempted to attack them. Several family members reportedly sustained injuries, including serious ones among the women. They have also secured CCTV footage of the incident.

No written complaint has been filed yet. Police say they are analysing the viral video and CCTV footage, and action will be taken based on the preliminary investigation.
